summary.intent: Plan and execute Phase 58 (IPNS Signature-Verify Coverage) of the CipherBox project end-to-end: generate PLAN.md files via research → plan → verify, then run the full ship pipeline (security audit, Nyquist validation, SDK E2E gate, CodeRabbit CLI, conventional-commit reword, PR creation, and review resolution).
summary.outcome: Phase 58 was fully planned (4 plans, 2 waves), executed (all 4 plans complete), and passed formal verification (7/7 must-haves, D-01..D-13 confirmed in code). The ship pipeline completed gates 1–6; CodeRabbit CLI returned 5 findings that were being applied by a sub-agent before the reword/push/PR steps.

repo: SDK E2E secret: `TEST_LOGIN_SECRET` in `apps/api/.env` is `e2e-test-secret-ci-only`; pass it as `SDK_E2E_SECRET` when running the suite. A mismatch silently causes 401 → whole suite skips, which executors misclassify as 'infra-limited'.
vitest 3 does not auto-load `tests/sdk-e2e/.env`; env vars must be set explicitly on the CLI.
The commit helper reports `commit_failed` as a known false negative — always verify with `git log --oneline -1`, never blindly retry.
`gh pr edit` fails on this repo (Projects-classic GraphQL); patch PR body via `env -u GITHUB_TOKEN gh api -X PATCH repos/FSM1/cipher-box/pulls/<N> -F body=@file`.
`github-actions[bot]` pushes a `chore(release)` commit to the branch after PR creation; `git fetch` + rebase before any subsequent push or it is rejected.
Conventional-commit subjects with parentheses (e.g. `feat(58-04): ... (7 cases)`) fail the `pr-release-preview` CI gate and `lint-pr-title`; strip trailing parens before push.
`markdownlint` runs on commit but excludes `.planning/`; no need to lint files there.
`git rebase -i` is unavailable in this environment; use `git filter-branch --msg-filter` for commit subject rewording.
5 REQ-IDs (IPNS-05/06, DB-01/02, BYO-08) are missing from the REQUIREMENTS.md traceability table — pre-existing hygiene debt unrelated to HARD-09.
Desktop Tauri codebase (`apps/desktop/src-tauri/`) has 6 unverified `resolve_ipns` call sites in prepopulate.rs and vault.rs that were explicitly deferred in 58-01 and remain at baseline.
`phase.complete` reports false-positive 'needs human verification' when `previous_status: human_needed` appears in frontmatter history.

code.finding: Uses `btoa(String.fromCharCode(...cbor))` for CBOR→base64; CodeRabbit flagged as potentially corrupting bytes >127. Replace with `Buffer.from(cbor).toString('base64')` for clarity and silence pre-ship warnings.
Missing explicit existence check on `cborFields['Sequence']` before BigInt coercion; should throw a clear binding-mismatch error if the field is absent.
Missing unit tests for u64-overflow sequence wrapping and invalid-UTF-8 CBOR Value rejection — genuine coverage gaps identified by CodeRabbit CLI.
Uses unchecked `seq + 1` arithmetic where the crate convention is `checked_add`; fixed by code-review agent (WR-01) to prevent silent overflow.
Imports `ciborium` directly; requires `ciborium` in `crates/fuse/Cargo.toml` (line 43). The 58-01 executor's mid-crash diagnostic falsely reported this as missing — the dep was already added.

workflow: For multi-crate crypto phases, sequential execution on the feature branch is safer than parallel worktrees — avoids cwd-drift, merge failures, and stranded worktree machinery.
Executor agents spawned for one plan can silently continue into the next plan if not explicitly bounded; validate which plans actually landed via `git log` after each agent returns.
The SDK E2E suite is the only gate that exercises the real client→API IPNS publish/resolve round-trip; unit suites mock the boundary and miss integration regressions.
Full client-chain rebuild (`pnpm --filter ... build` across crypto→core→api-client→sdk-core→sdk→api) is required before running SDK E2E to ensure `dist/` matches CI.
Commit history reword must happen before the first push; rewording after push requires a force-push that risks clobbering the `github-actions[bot]` `chore(release)` commit.
CodeRabbit CLI (`coderabbit review --agent --base main --type committed`) should run pre-ship to triage findings before the PR-level re-review adds noise.
Pattern mapper agent (produces PATTERNS.md classifying relevant files) is a useful pre-planning step for large multi-file phases.

A socket-dropped executor leaves partial progress in uncommitted diffs; a continuation agent that validates the existing commits and resumes from the exact incomplete task is more reliable than a full re-run.

friction: 58-01 executor crashed mid-task due to API socket close after committing 3 of 5 tasks; Task 3 (FUSE routing) was done-but-uncommitted and Task 4 (JS binding) was not started, requiring a separate continuation agent.

SDK E2E was silently skipped by the executor as 'infra-limited' due to TEST_LOGIN_SECRET mismatch; the suite 401s and skips entirely with no diagnostic output, making it look like an infra problem rather than a config error.
One executor dispatched for 58-02 autonomously continued into 58-03 without being asked, blurring plan attribution and making it harder to audit which plan produced which commits.
The `commit_failed` false negative from the commit helper caused unnecessary uncertainty and required `git log` verification after every commit.

Probing the test-login endpoint shape to diagnose the SDK E2E secret issue required guessing the payload format; `curl` returned 400 (wrong payload shape) for both secrets, masking the actual secret mismatch.
CodeRabbit CLI review took 10+ minutes, creating a blocking wait in the ship pipeline.
The `(7 cases)` parens in one commit subject (`f882d02ea`) require a `filter-branch` reword before push — a mechanical step that must not be forgotten.
